notes.text: Unbanded line 2 (y 715-773) is a speck far out in the left margin, not printed text; nothing to absorb.

Colophon 'Записано отъ чукчи Рэмкыlын'а на р. Молондѣ' is indented and left-aligned, not centred, so left as MainZone-P; same for line 29. The editor may prefer MainZone-Other for these non-prose informant lines.
